title: Chechen — BGN/PCGN 2008
description: BGN/PCGN romanization of Chechen Cyrillic with its digraphs: ГӀ→ġ, Кх→q, Къ→q̇, КӀ→kh, ПӀ→ph, ТӀ→th, Хь→ẋ, ХӀ→h, ЦӀ→ċ, ЧӀ→ç̇, Аь Оь Уь Юь Яь → ä ö ü yü yä, Ж→z̵, Х→x, Ц→c, Ч→ç, Ш→ş, lone Ӏ→j.
notes: Not applied because they cannot be detected from spelling: ə for short а (note 1) and ŋ for н before a nasalized vowel (note 5).
Е→ye word- and syllable-initially (note 2), approximated as: word-initially and after a vowel, ъ or ь.
Ё, Щ, Ъ, Ы occur only in loans (note 3): yo, şç, ’, i.

Palochka: U+04C0 and U+04CF are both accepted (U+04CF is folded to U+04C0 so that all-caps names stay all-caps); Cyrillic І/і is aliased to it. Latin look-alikes I, l, 1, |, Ⅰ and ǀ are treated as palochka only directly after г к п т х ц ч (the digraph positions); they are not aliased globally, so Latin text is untouched.
Case workaround: a lone palochka in mid-word (дӀа → dja) is output as j, and a post rule lower-cases the J the engine would otherwise produce from the upper-case code point U+04C0.
Outputs with combining marks follow the PCGN inventory: q̇ = q+U+0307, ç̇ = ç+U+0307, z̵ = z+U+0335; ġ, ẋ, ċ are stored NFC-composed.
